text: Every stripe is a tone; its width tells how well it fits the chord that sounds.
A harmonic playing field in the browser: one hand holds the chord, the other plays the tones that fit it, live.
Listeners scan the code, see the lyrics scroll in sync on their phone and applaud; the music stays in the room where the player is.
The player sends sync points with server time, listeners align their clocks via a ping median, estimate the tempo from the last onsets and run at most one syllable ahead.

QR codes in plain JavaScript: byte mode, versions one to ten, error correction level M, Reed-Solomon over GF(256), BCH format and version information, eight masks scored by the four penalty rules and a quiet zone!
